svg.title: Transactional Outbox
svg.desc: Transactional Outbox. Save the event in the same database transaction as the data, then relay it: no dual-write gap. Step 1, The dual-write gap: Dual write: the order commits, then the service crashes before it publishes. The event is lost. Step 2, One local transaction: Insert the order and an outbox row (the event) in one local transaction: both commit or neither. Step 3, Relay: at-least-once: A relay publishes unsent rows and marks them sent. It crashes in between, so a7f3 is sent twice. Step 4, Idempotent consumers: Each consumer sees that it has already processed a7f3 and skips the duplicate. Order holds per key.
